accountBinding: Upload practice media through the normal authenticated Studio entry. The starter is fresh and belongs to that account. This recipe transfers no owner, Storage path, cloud allowance or completed render.

steps.title: Open the normal case
steps.why: Use the six-second source interval from the trimming lesson.

steps.title: Create a text layer
steps.why: Use an explanatory label. Automatic transcription is not required.

steps.title: Set text timing
steps.why: The label should appear after the conversion and leave enough time for the viewer to read it.

steps.title: Set a readable position
steps.control: Graphics → Lower; Motion → Transform keyframes → Target layer → Y
steps.why: Choose the text layer, then set Y to 93%. This keeps the label below the test cards instead of covering their headings. Increasing Y moves the layer down the frame.

steps.title: Choose text appearance
steps.control: Title size; Title text color; Title background color
steps.value: Inter; size 100%; white #ffffff; background #0b1020; Headline defaults: weight 900, 45% box, 0.3 s entrance/exit fades
steps.why: Check the actual result at lesson size. Do not rely on a small thumbnail.

steps.title: Preview, save and export
steps.why: The words, timing and placement must agree in preview and export. If they do not, do not hand in the video.
